title: Index of the Halting State Variable
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean tape symbols and every natural number $n$, the variable assigned to the absent state (the halting state) is the state offset $2n+2$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
